extraction.notes: No official 2027 camp information or year-specific 2026 camp page was found. The services page still lists Fledgling at $350/week and Wings at $450/week, but does not identify a summer year; these prices were not assigned to 2026 or 2027. Search found official registration PDFs from 2016–2018, but they could not be opened and their historical dates and eligibility were not carried forward. A third-party mirror of a March 16, 2026 social post describes an unnamed horse camp for ages 6 and up, June 15–19, July 20–24 and July 27–31, 9am–1pm; its connection to the two named programs could not be established, so those details were not assigned to either card.
